authority.legacyCivilianPhaseRole: bootstrap/fallback compatibility only; phase advancement is disabled while normal compiler-route authority is active
authority.physicalAgentAuthority: TrafficDriverRuntime adopts native impacts into actual poses; no route-offset recovery authority in production
authority.junctionFlow: TrafficDriverJunctions; whole-body path permits, clear physical approaches and downstream exits, explicit denial dependencies, inside-first clearance. Queued rear cars cannot reserve over their leaders.
authority.journeyPlanner: TrafficJourneyPlanner; broad repeating circuits with continuous seams. Civilian through routes exclude cul-de-sacs; prescribed bus terminal itineraries may use them.
authority.circuitAllocation: TrafficPopulationPolicy; deterministic bootstrap allocation against source-road and district capacity, without changing routes or physical poses after startup
authority.publicTransport: TransitRoutes selects compiler curb lanes and prescribed itineraries. TransitSystem owns stops, passenger state and service braking; TrafficDriverRuntime/VehicleModel move buses, NpcSystem moves commuters, InteractionSystem owns the chooser.
authority.performance: TrafficDriverRuntime schedules distant unmaterialized civilians at staggered 2 Hz and keeps assigned cars, buses and emergencies under shared physical integration. Incremental route accounting and lazy diagnostics are read-only projections; body geometry and spatial candidates do not own movement.
